thread:
Jordan: Heads-up — customer asked for continuous streaming chat that can call external tools mid-stream and emit schema-validated JSON frames for downstream ETL. Ticket #3421. They want low-latency partial tool outputs, valid JSON chunks per event, and a graceful fallback to full-response mode if toolchain is slow. Requesting product prioritization.

Mira: Linking ticket https://redwood.help/tickets/3421 — customer: Acme Health (HIPAA-adj). They require VPC/private deployment. Problem they reported: tool emits partial JSON and their stream consumer breaks because framing is not preserved. They explicitly said "each event must be parseable as standalone JSON".

Alex: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) QPS and typical token payload sizes? 2) Do they need interleaved multiple toolcalls inside one stream, or single fncall semantics? 3) What’s their minimum acceptance criteria for us to consider this GA?

Sam: From runtime perspective: interleaved toolcalls + structured streaming requires a framing protocol (len-prefixed JSON or NDJSON with explicit envelope types). Today we stream raw tokens/newlines only. Enforcing chunk-level JSON validation means buffering/parse/validate per event — CPU + memory cost. Rough timeline: spec + prototype + SDK changes = ~2–3 sprints depending on scope.

Alex: Suggested acceptance criteria for intake: - SDKs accept an "event" envelope with type in {"chunk","tool_event","done"} - All envelopes are NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) for streaming parseability - Backwards-compatible: clients opt-in via a new param (stream_format="ndjson_envelope") - Fallback mode: if tool latency > threshold, stream a single final response and emit a warning event - Security: ensure tool_event metadata does not leak PII.

Jordan: Sales note: Acme Health said they'd sign up for Dedicated capacity if we can commit to an ETA. They're sensitive to compliance and uptime. Need a rough ETA to include in the proposal.

Mira: I'll ask for their QPS, token sizes, and sample payloads. Also marking QA checklist: regression tests for partial streaming, SDK parser robustness, and private deployment test matrix.

Sam: Prototype plan from eng: (a) write framing spec doc, (b) implement opt-in parser/serializer in runtime, (c) SDK helpers for parse/unwrap. Example envelope we might use: ```{"type":"tool_event","id":"req123","payload":{"status":"partial","data":"..."}}``` — NDJSON stream would be a sequence of these lines. Also flag: KV-cache behavior during mid-stream tool calls needs investigation.

Alex: Next steps: intake meeting Wed 11am PT to scope acceptance and decide spike. @Sam can you post rough story points before the meeting?

Sam: Will do today. Initial guess: 8–13 points for a minimal opt-in feature (runtime + SDK), 20+ if we require full multi-tool interleaving + strict validation + Dedicated perf tuning.

Jordan: Thanks all — tagging Legal for HIPAA check. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Meeting created: Wed 11am PT (calendar invite sent to participants).
